about: The GENESIS building library. One entry per 3D model: what it is, where and when it belongs, how big it really is, and the generation jobs it came from. tools/models/pipeline.mjs turns every entry with a src into game-ready LOD files.

style.reference: Every concept image is generated with the set's anchor image attached as a style reference, so lighting, camera, background and material character match across the whole library.
style.prefix: Use the attached image only as the style reference: same photographic look, same soft lighting, same camera height and angle, same plain light-grey background. Show a different building:
style.suffix: Three-quarter view from the front-left, camera slightly above at about 30 degrees elevation, the entire structure visible and centred with clear margin around it. Photorealistic archaeological reconstruction, historically accurate construction details, natural weathering. Soft even overcast lighting, no harsh shadows, no cast shadow on the ground. Plain flat light-grey studio background, no ground plane, no people, no animals, no plants, no other objects, no text.
style.chain: A building that is the later form of an earlier one (a house of the next age, a higher wall, the gate of a wall) is generated with the earlier one's concept image attached as its reference, so upgrades keep the same materials and workmanship.

tree.note: Trees are photographed on a blue screen and cut out by tools/models/card.mjs (the first four, on the grey studio backdrop, are keyed by distance from it). The oak is the style reference for all of them.
tree.prefix: Use the attached image only as the style reference for the photographic look, the soft lighting and the camera height and angle. Show a different tree:
tree.suffix: The whole tree from the foot of the trunk to the top of the crown, seen from the side at eye level, upright and centred, with clear margin all around it. Photorealistic, botanically accurate. Soft even overcast lighting, no harsh shadows, no cast shadow. The background is one flat uniform pure chroma-key blue (#1433ff) filling the whole frame from edge to edge like a blue screen: no ground, no grass, no horizon, no gradient, no vignette, no people, no animals, no other plants, no other objects, no text.
tree.winter: The attached image shows an oak tree in summer. Show this same tree in mid-winter:

stone.note: 10,000 BC to the first metal: wattle, daub, mud brick, hide, bark, reed and grass thatch, rough megaliths. No dressed stone, no fired brick, no tiles, no glass.

bronze.note: First cities to early iron: sun-dried mud brick, mud plaster, rammed earth, rubble stone, timber, reed and thatch. Fired brick only as facing on great works, dressed stone only on monuments. No true arches, no roof tiles, no glass.

nature.note: Trees. Generated meshes get trunks right and crowns wrong, so a tree is drawn as its concept photograph, cut out, on a card that faces the camera (card: true). Most have no mesh at all. tree: where it grows (weights by flora zone: boreal, temperate, med, easia, dry, savanna, rain; region: [lon0, lon1, lat0, lat1]), whether it sheds its leaves, and which card shows it leafless.

models.title: Round house of the first farmers
Mud-brick town wall
models.prompt: a straight free-standing section of a Bronze Age town wall, about 12 m long, 6 m high and 2.5 m thick, sun-dried mud brick on a rough field-stone footing, weathered mud plaster, a wall-walk behind a parapet with square crenellations, both ends cut flat so sections join end to end

models.title: Mud-brick courtyard house
models.prompt: a Mesopotamian courtyard house of about 2000 BC, single storey, about 12 m square around a small open court, thick mud-plastered mud-brick walls, flat roof of palm beams, reed matting and packed mud with a low parapet, one wooden door, ventilation slits, roof-drain spouts, a ladder in the court, storage jars on the roof

models.title: Log house with reed thatch
models.prompt: an early Iron Age house in the manner of Biskupin, about 9 by 7 m, horizontal split logs slotted into grooved corner posts on a field-stone sill, steep gabled roof of reed thatch held by crossed ridge poles, plank gables with a smoke opening, one low plank door

models.title: Oak
models.prompt: a mature European oak about 18 m tall, broad dense rounded crown of deep green summer foliage in full leaf masses, thick gnarled trunk dividing into a few heavy limbs, roots flaring at the base

models.title: Aegean town house
models.prompt: an Aegean town house of about 1600 BC in the manner of Akrotiri, two storeys, about 8 by 7 m and 6.5 m high, rubble stone bound with clay and laced with timber beams, flaking pale ochre plaster, dressed stone corners, flat roof of beams, reeds and earth, timber-framed door and windows

models.title: Shang house on a rammed-earth platform
models.prompt: a house of northern China of about 1200 BC, about 8 by 5 m on a low platform of pounded yellow earth, rammed-earth and wattle-and-daub walls between timber posts, steep hipped grass-thatch roof with wide eaves on slender posts, plank door in the long side, no windows

models.title: Formative Mesoamerican house
models.prompt: a village house of Formative Mesoamerica of about 800 BC, about 7 by 4.5 m on a low platform faced with river cobbles and clay, wattle-and-daub walls partly whitewashed, tall steep hipped palm-thatch roof, one open doorway with a wooden lintel

models.title: Bark longhouse
models.prompt: a longhouse of the Eastern Woodlands, about 20 m long, 6 m wide and 6 m high, an arched frame of bent saplings covered with overlapping sheets of elm bark held by an outer lattice of poles, barrel roof with smoke holes, a hide-hung doorway at each end

models.title: Mud-brick town gate
models.prompt: the gate of the mud-brick town wall: a 3.5 m passage between two projecting rectangular gate towers about 9 m high with crenellated tops, a timber fighting platform over the passage, a two-leaf plank gate bound in bronze standing open, side ends cut flat at the wall's height and thickness

models.title: Mud-brick wall tower
models.prompt: a free-standing rectangular tower of the mud-brick town wall, about 6 m square and 10 m high, slightly sloping walls on a field-stone footing, weathered plaster, narrow slits, a crenellated fighting platform, projecting roof beams

models.title: Ziggurat
models.prompt: a Sumerian ziggurat of about 2100 BC in the manner of Ur: three receding terraces, about 45 by 30 m and 20 m high, mud-brick core faced with fired brick, buttressed sloping walls, three monumental stairs meeting at a gate tower, a small plastered shrine on top

models.title: Mycenaean megaron
models.prompt: a Mycenaean megaron of about 1300 BC: a hall about 12 by 23 m and 7 m high, plastered rubble and timber walls on large limestone blocks, a deep porch with two tapering dark-red wooden columns on stone bases, flat clay roof with a parapet, a painted blue and red frieze, a clay smoke vent

models.title: Chieftain's great hall
models.prompt: the great hall of a Bronze Age chieftain of northern Europe: a three-aisled timber hall about 28 by 9 m, low wattle-and-daub and plank walls between oak posts, a very tall steep reed-thatched roof with crossed ridge poles, a wide double door under a small thatched porch on carved posts

models.title: Shang palace hall
models.prompt: a Shang dynasty palace hall of about 1300 BC: about 28 by 11 m on a stepped platform of pounded yellow earth, a veranda of thick timber columns on stone bases, plastered rammed-earth walls with three plank doors, a double-eaved hipped grass-thatch roof, a broad flight of earthen steps

models.title: Early stupa
models.prompt: an early stupa of about 250 BC in the manner of the first stupa at Sanchi: a solid brick dome about 18 m across coated in weathered lime plaster on a low circular terrace with a stair, a square railing and parasol mast on top, a plain circular wooden railing with one post-and-lintel gateway around it

models.title: Formative temple platform
models.prompt: an early Mesoamerican temple platform of about 600 BC: four receding terraces about 30 m square and 15 m high, packed clay and rubble faced with river cobbles under weathered dull-red lime plaster, one broad stair, a small wattle-and-daub temple with a tall palm-thatch roof on top

models.title: Courtyard palace
models.prompt: a Mesopotamian courtyard house of about 2000 BC, single storey, about 12 m square around a small open court, thick mud-plastered mud-brick walls, flat roof of palm beams, reed matting and packed mud with a low parapet, one wooden door, ventilation slits, roof-drain spouts, a ladder in the court, storage jars on the roof

models.title: Great pyramid
models.prompt: an Egyptian pyramid of the Old Kingdom as newly finished: a true smooth-sided pyramid on a square base, sides at about 52 degrees, cased in fine white limestone with hair-thin joints, faintly weather-stained near the base, a small gilded capstone, a low limestone plinth

models.title: Market shelter and stalls
models.prompt: a Bronze Age market: an open-sided shelter about 14 by 7 m with a reed-thatch roof on rough timber posts, under and beside it trestle tables laden with baskets of grain and fruit, pottery, bundles of wool and cloth, dried fish, copper ingots, two striped cloth awnings on poles

models.title: Norway spruce
models.prompt: a mature Norway spruce about 24 m tall, dense narrow conical crown of dark green needles in layered drooping branches reaching almost to the ground, straight trunk with reddish-brown scaly bark visible only at the base

models.title: Umbrella thorn acacia
models.prompt: a mature umbrella thorn acacia about 9 m tall and 12 m across, wide flat-topped crown of fine dense grey-green foliage on a few strong spreading branches, short thick trunk with dark fissured bark forking low

models.title: Date palm
models.prompt: a mature date palm about 15 m tall, a straight sturdy trunk patterned with the stubs of old leaf bases, a dense full rounded head of long arching grey-green fronds, hanging clusters of amber dates

models.title: Mud-brick house being built
models.prompt: the mud-brick house while it is being built, about 10 m square: walls of fresh unplastered brick at half to three-quarters height with stepped tops, the doorway open under its lintel, no roof, a pole scaffold and ladder, stacks of sun-dried bricks, a heap of mud mortar and a trough, palm beams lying ready

models.title: Timber house being built
models.prompt: the timber house while it is being built, about 10 by 6 m: oak posts on a field-stone sill joined by wall plates and tie beams, the first courses of logs in place, rafters with battens raised over the whole length, thatch laid on the lower courses of one end, a ladder, bundles of reed and a stack of trimmed logs

models.title: Platform mound
models.prompt: an earthen platform mound of the Eastern Woodlands: rectangular, flat-topped, about 40 by 30 m and 8 m high, steep turfed sides worn to clay in places, a ramp of log steps, on the summit a wattle-and-daub building with a steep thatched roof behind a low screen of posts

models.title: Barn and byre
models.prompt: a Bronze Age barn and cattle byre about 12 by 6 m: woven wattle hurdles between rough posts, open under the eaves, a steep thatched roof, a hurdle gate half open in the long side, hay and sheaves inside, a wooden feeding trough

models.title: Timber jetty
models.prompt: a straight section of an ancient timber jetty about 16 m long and 4 m wide: rough-hewn planks on heavy beams carried by two rows of driven tree-trunk piles about 3 m tall, weed-stained below, mooring posts with coils of rope, both ends cut flat so sections join end to end

models.title: Village well
models.prompt: a village well: a circular well-head of rough field stones about 1.8 m across and 0.8 m high, a frame of two forked posts and a crossbar with a fibre rope and leather bucket, a stone-lined drinking trough, a few paving stones

models.title: Sewn-plank trading boat
models.prompt: a Bronze Age trading boat about 12 m long and 3 m wide: a broad open hull of thick planks sewn and lashed, caulked with moss and pitch, high curved stem and stern, a short mast with a yard and furled linen sail, a steering oar, oars along the thwarts, clay jars and bundles amidships

models.title: Scots pine
models.prompt: a mature Scots pine about 22 m tall, a tall bare trunk whose bark turns orange-red in the upper part, a flat-topped irregular crown of blue-green needles on a few twisted spreading branches

models.title: Stone pine
models.prompt: a mature Mediterranean stone pine about 16 m tall, a tall bare reddish-brown plated trunk dividing high up into upswept branches that carry one broad flat umbrella-shaped crown of dense dark green needles

models.title: Mediterranean cypress
models.prompt: a mature Mediterranean cypress about 20 m tall, a tall narrow dense dark green column tapering to a point, foliage down to near the ground, a short grey-brown trunk just visible at the foot

models.title: Rainforest tree
models.prompt: a tall tropical rainforest tree about 28 m tall, a straight brown trunk with low buttress roots, a broad dense rounded crown of large glossy dark green leaves beginning halfway up, a few lianas and epiphytes on the limbs

models.title: Silver birch
models.prompt: a mature silver birch about 17 m tall, a slender straight white trunk marked with black fissures, darkening and rugged at the foot, a light airy narrow crown of fine drooping twigs and small bright green leaves

models.title: European beech
models.prompt: a mature European beech about 24 m tall grown in the open, a smooth silver-grey trunk, a tall dense domed crown of fresh green leaves in layered sprays reaching down to within a few metres of the ground

models.title: Olive
models.prompt: an old olive tree about 7 m tall and 8 m across, a thick gnarled twisted hollowed grey trunk, a rounded open crown of small narrow silvery grey-green leaves

models.title: Kapok
models.prompt: a giant rainforest kapok tree about 42 m tall, a straight pale grey columnar trunk with tall plank buttress roots at the foot, bare of branches for two thirds of its height, then a wide spreading umbrella crown of horizontal limbs with dense green foliage and a few hanging lianas

models.title: Baobab
models.prompt: a mature African baobab about 18 m tall, an enormous swollen smooth grey-brown bottle-shaped trunk about 7 m thick, short stout tapering branches spreading from its top like roots, sparse small green leaves

models.title: Giant bamboo
models.prompt: a clump of giant timber bamboo about 14 m tall, some thirty straight jointed green culms rising close together from one base and arching outward at the top, feathery light green leaves along the upper half

models.title: Oak in winter
models.prompt: the same thick gnarled trunk, the same heavy limbs, the same size and place in the frame, but completely leafless, its broad rounded crown now an intricate tracery of bare grey-brown branches and fine twigs, not a single leaf
